name: Topiramate
summary: Topiramate, marketed as Topamax among other names, is an oral medication primarily prescribed for the treatment of epilepsy and the prophylaxis of migraines. For epilepsy, this includes treatment for generalized or focal seizures. It has also been used off-label for alcohol dependence and essential tremor.

pharmacology.text: Its mechanism of action is unclear.

uses.text: Topiramate is used to treat epilepsy in children and adults, and it was originally used as an anticonvulsant. In children, it is indicated for the treatment of Lennox-Gastaut syndrome, a disorder that causes seizures and developmental delay. It is most frequently prescribed for the prevention of migraines, as it decreases the frequency of attacks.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include tingling, feeling tired, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, weight loss, and cognitive dysfunction, such as trouble concentrating. Serious side effects may include suicidal ideation, increased ammonia levels resulting in encephalopathy, and kidney stones.
